## Safety checklist

- [ ] I searched profiles, issues, and pull requests for duplicates.
- [ ] I used primary or official evidence where available.
- [ ] I used `unknown` instead of assuming compatibility or access.
- [ ] I did not install or execute cataloged software for this change.
- [ ] I included no secrets, credentials, private paths, private endpoints, or personal data.
- [ ] I preserved the documentation-only boundary.

## Quality checklist

- [ ] Folder, status, risk, and resource type agree.
- [ ] Registry and profile references agree.
- [ ] Generated indexes were refreshed when catalog data changed.
- [ ] Documentation and examples were updated without duplicating existing guidance.
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_registry.py` passes.
